storyTitle: MGNREGA Completes 20 Years: A Data-Driven Assessment of Rural Employment
tierChangeRationale: Active statutory law (Act No. 42 of 2005); zero Gazette repeal/replacement notifications exist. FY24 budget ₹86,000 cr & 14.3 cr active workers verified via MoRD MIS return.
domainFactCheckDetails: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act, 2005 (Act No. 42 of 2005). Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per rural household per FY. Current legal status: Active statutory law; ZERO Gazette notifications or parliamentary bills exist replacing or renaming the Act. Budget FY 2023-24 RE: ₹86,000 crore. Active Workers: 14.3 crore. Registered Households: 15.4 crore. Average days per household: 47.4 days.
